resources.string: A simple PDF reader designed especially for people with low vision, but usable by everyone.
To begin, open ☰ and choose Open document. In normal view you can scroll, zoom, search and select text. Text Reflow adapts readable text to the screen.

Text Reflow changes the original layout and may omit images, columns, tables and formatting. For legal, medical, tax, form-based or other documents where the original layout matters, use the original PDF view or another application suited to that purpose.
The app opens only documents you choose. It does not require general access to your files and it does not need an Internet connection.
This document is password protected. This reader does not manage passwords. Use another application to open it.
The document is damaged or is not supported by this reader. Use another application to open it.
